name: communitypulse
author: Taako
description: Privacy-conscious community health analytics with onboarding funnels, activation, retention cohorts, role adoption, inactivity queues, churn counts, buffered writes, and CSV exports.
install_msg: CommunityPulse loaded disabled. Review its data statement, then enable it with `[p]communitypulse enable`.
short: Onboarding, activation, retention, churn, inactivity, and role-adoption analytics.
end_user_data_statement: When enabled, this cog stores Discord user IDs, join/leave/first-message/last-message timestamps, aggregate message counts, and current non-managed role IDs for community health analysis. It does not store message content. Buffered activity is written every five minutes.
